text.description_html:
Deltana ZA2010, ZA Series Modern Value Wall Mounted Towel or Robe Hook

A hook such as this is as useful in the kitchen as it is in the bathroom. A stylish way to hang a robe, towels, or even a lady's purse, it's a beautiful, modern way to keep things off the floor in any room. The contemporary square shape brings interesting design to the lowly towel hook. This bathroom towel hook is made from zinc and aluminum with the attention to quality that Deltana is known for. The Modern Value Series Robe Hook a sleek contemporary look that will look good in even the most fashionable homes. It is available in either satin nickel or polished chrome finishes.

Shop more of the Deltana ZA Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the Modern Value Series Bathroom or Kitchen Towel Hook:

  • Material: zinc and aluminum
  • Projection: 1-3/4"
  • Overall Length: 3-5/8"
  • Overall Height: 1-1/8"
  • Tip Height: 7/8"
  • Wall Mount Length: 1-1/8" squared
  • Deltana ZA2010 ZA Series Double Robe Hook Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 robe hook, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
